cuad_categories.description: The name of the contract
cuad_categories.name: Document Name

cuad_categories.description: The two or more parties who signed the contract
cuad_categories.name: Parties

cuad_categories.description: The date of the contract
cuad_categories.name: Agreement Date

cuad_categories.description: The date when the contract is effective
cuad_categories.name: Effective Date

cuad_categories.description: On what date will the contract's initial term expire?
cuad_categories.name: Expiration Date

cuad_categories.description: What is the renewal term after the initial term expires? This includes automatic extensions and unilateral extensions with prior notice.
cuad_categories.name: Renewal Term

cuad_categories.description: What is the notice period required to terminate renewal?
cuad_categories.name: Notice Period To Terminate Renewal

cuad_categories.description: Which state/country's law governs the interpretation of the contract?
cuad_categories.name: Governing Law

cuad_categories.description: Is there a clause that if a third party gets better terms on the licensing or sale of technology/goods/services described in the contract, the buyer of such technology/goods/services under the contract shall be entitled to those better terms?
cuad_categories.name: Most Favored Nation

cuad_categories.description: This category includes the exceptions or carveouts to Non-Compete, Exclusivity and No-Solicit of Customers above.
cuad_categories.name: Competitive Restriction Exception

cuad_categories.description: Is there a restriction on the ability of a party to compete with the counterparty or operate in a certain geography or business or technology sector?
cuad_categories.name: Non-Compete

cuad_categories.description: Is there an exclusive dealing commitment with the counterparty? This includes a commitment to procure all "requirements" from one party of certain technology, goods, or services or a prohibition on licensing or selling technology, goods or services to third parties, or a prohibition on collaborating or working with other parties), whether during the contract or after the contract ends (or both).
cuad_categories.name: Exclusivity

cuad_categories.description: Is a party restricted from contracting or soliciting customers or partners of the counterparty, whether during the contract or after the contract ends (or both)?
cuad_categories.name: No-Solicit Of Customers

cuad_categories.description: Is there a restriction on a party's soliciting or hiring employees and/or contractors from the counterparty, whether during the contract or after the contract ends (or both)?
cuad_categories.name: No-Solicit Of Employees

cuad_categories.description: Is there a requirement on a party not to disparage the counterparty?
cuad_categories.name: Non-Disparagement

cuad_categories.description: Can a party terminate this contract without cause (solely by giving a notice and allowing a waiting period to expire)?
cuad_categories.name: Termination For Convenience

cuad_categories.description: Is there a clause granting one party a right of first refusal, right of first offer or right of first negotiation to purchase, license, market, or distribute equity interest, technology, assets, products or services?
cuad_categories.name: Rofr/Rofo/Rofn

cuad_categories.description: Does one party have the right to terminate or is consent or notice required of the counterparty if such party undergoes a change of control, such as a merger, stock sale, transfer of all or substantially all of its assets or business, or assignment by operation of law?
cuad_categories.name: Change Of Control

cuad_categories.description: Is consent or notice required of a party if the contract is assigned to a third party?
cuad_categories.name: Anti-Assignment

cuad_categories.description: Is one party required to share revenue or profit with the counterparty for any technology, goods, or services?
cuad_categories.name: Revenue/Profit Sharing

cuad_categories.description: Is there a restriction on the ability of a party to raise or reduce prices of technology, goods, or services provided?
cuad_categories.name: Price Restrictions

cuad_categories.description: Is there a minimum order size or minimum amount or units per-time period that one party must buy from the counterparty under the contract?
cuad_categories.name: Minimum Commitment

cuad_categories.description: Is there a fee increase or consent requirement, etc. if one party's use of the product/services exceeds certain threshold?
cuad_categories.name: Volume Restriction

cuad_categories.description: Does intellectual property created by one party become the property of the counterparty, either per the terms of the contract or upon the occurrence of certain events?
cuad_categories.name: Ip Ownership Assignment

cuad_categories.description: Is there any clause providing for joint or shared ownership of intellectual property between the parties to the contract?
cuad_categories.name: Joint Ip Ownership

cuad_categories.description: Does the contract contain a license granted by one party to its counterparty?
cuad_categories.name: License Grant

cuad_categories.description: Does the contract limit the ability of a party to transfer the license being granted to a third party?
cuad_categories.name: Non-Transferable License

cuad_categories.description: Does the contract contain a license grant by affiliates of the licensor or that includes intellectual property of affiliates of the licensor?
cuad_categories.name: Affiliate License-Licensor

cuad_categories.description: Does the contract contain a license grant to a licensee (incl. sublicensor) and the affiliates of such licensee/sublicensor?
cuad_categories.name: Affiliate License-Licensee

cuad_categories.description: Is there a clause granting one party an "enterprise," "all you can eat" or unlimited usage license?
cuad_categories.name: Unlimited/All-You-Can-Eat-License

cuad_categories.description: Does the contract contain a license grant that is irrevocable or perpetual?
cuad_categories.name: Irrevocable Or Perpetual License

cuad_categories.description: Is one party required to deposit its source code into escrow with a third party, which can be released to the counterparty upon the occurrence of certain events (bankruptcy, insolvency, etc.)?
cuad_categories.name: Source Code Escrow

cuad_categories.description: Is a party subject to obligations after the termination or expiration of a contract, including any post-termination transition, payment, transfer of IP, wind-down, last-buy, or similar obligations?
cuad_categories.name: Post-Termination Services

cuad_categories.description: Does a party have the right to audit the books, records, or physical locations of the counterparty to ensure compliance with the contract?
cuad_categories.name: Audit Rights

cuad_categories.description: Is a party's liability uncapped upon the breach of its obligation in the contract? This also includes uncap liability for a particular type of breach such as IP infringement or breach of confidentiality obligation.
cuad_categories.name: Uncapped Liability

cuad_categories.description: Does the contract include a cap on liability upon the breach of a party's obligation? This includes time limitation for the counterparty to bring claims or maximum amount for recovery.
cuad_categories.name: Cap On Liability

cuad_categories.description: Does the contract contain a clause that would award either party liquidated damages for breach or a fee upon the termination of a contract (termination fee)?
cuad_categories.name: Liquidated Damages

cuad_categories.description: What is the duration of any warranty against defects or errors in technology, products, or services provided under the contract?
cuad_categories.name: Warranty Duration

cuad_categories.description: Is there a requirement for insurance that must be maintained by one party for the benefit of the counterparty?
cuad_categories.name: Insurance

cuad_categories.description: Is a party restricted from contesting the validity of the counterparty's ownership of intellectual property or otherwise bringing a claim against the counterparty for matters unrelated to the contract?
cuad_categories.name: Covenant Not To Sue

cuad_categories.description: Is there a non-contracting party who is a beneficiary to some or all of the clauses in the contract and therefore can enforce its rights against a contracting party?
cuad_categories.name: Third Party Beneficiary

cuad_families.definition: Affiliate or referral-program agreement: a publisher or partner promotes the counterparty's products for a commission or referral fee.

family_fields.description: Territory or channels the affiliate may promote in
family_fields.name: program_territory

cuad_families.label: Affiliate Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Agency agreement: one party (agent) represents or sells for the other (principal), usually for a commission.

family_fields.description: Which party is principal and which is agent
family_fields.name: principal_and_agent

cuad_families.label: Agency Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Collaboration or cooperation agreement: parties pool R&D or other effort toward a shared program.

family_fields.description: How costs and revenue are split
family_fields.name: cost_sharing

cuad_families.label: Collaboration / Cooperation Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Co-branding agreement: parties combine marks or properties on jointly branded products, sites or campaigns.

family_fields.description: Product, site or program carrying both brands
family_fields.name: co_branded_product

cuad_families.label: Co-Branding Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Consulting or advisory services agreement: a consultant provides expertise for fees.

family_fields.description: Hourly rate, retainer or fixed fee
family_fields.name: fee_structure

cuad_families.label: Consulting Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Development agreement: one party builds a product, software or deliverable, often against milestones.

family_fields.description: Product or software to be developed
family_fields.name: deliverables

cuad_families.label: Development Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Distributor agreement: a distributor buys and resells the supplier's goods in a territory.
cuad_families.label: Distributor Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Endorsement agreement (or rider): a person or entity lends name, likeness or reputation to promote a product.

family_fields.description: Person or entity giving the endorsement
family_fields.name: endorser

cuad_families.label: Endorsement Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Franchise agreement: a franchisor grants the right to operate under its system and marks in exchange for fees.

family_fields.description: Initial franchise fee and royalty rate
family_fields.name: franchise_fees

cuad_families.label: Franchise Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Hosting agreement: a provider hosts web sites, applications or data for a customer.

family_fields.description: Site, application or data being hosted
family_fields.name: hosted_service

cuad_families.label: Hosting Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Intellectual-property agreement: assignment, transfer or licensing of patents, marks, copyrights or software.

family_fields.description: Patents, marks, copyrights or software covered
family_fields.name: ip_assets

family_fields.description: Purchase price or royalty for the IP
family_fields.name: consideration

cuad_families.label: IP Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Joint-venture agreement: parties form or operate a shared venture or project and divide contributions and returns.

family_fields.description: Name of the joint venture entity or project
family_fields.name: venture_entity

cuad_families.label: Joint Venture Agreement

cuad_families.definition: License agreement: one party licenses technology, content or IP to another, typically for royalties.

family_fields.description: Exclusive / non-exclusive, field of use, sublicensing
family_fields.name: license_scope

cuad_families.label: License Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Maintenance or support agreement: a provider keeps software, equipment or systems operating.
cuad_families.label: Maintenance Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Manufacturing agreement: one party makes goods to specification for another, often with supply commitments.
cuad_families.label: Manufacturing Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Marketing agreement: a party markets, promotes or co-promotes products or services.

family_fields.description: Fees or commission for marketing services
family_fields.name: marketing_fees

cuad_families.label: Marketing Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Restrictive-covenant agreement: non-compete, non-solicit and non-disparagement undertakings.
cuad_families.label: Non-Compete / No-Solicit / Non-Disparagement Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Outsourcing agreement: a provider takes over a business process or function for a customer.
cuad_families.label: Outsourcing Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Promotion agreement: promotional services, campaigns or co-promotion of a product.
cuad_families.label: Promotion Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Reseller agreement: a reseller or value-added reseller buys or licenses products to resell to customers.
cuad_families.label: Reseller Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Service agreement: general professional, support or operational services for fees.
cuad_families.label: Service Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Sponsorship agreement: a sponsor funds an event, team or content in exchange for promotional benefits.

family_fields.description: Rights and benefits the sponsor receives
family_fields.name: sponsor_benefits

cuad_families.label: Sponsorship Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Strategic-alliance agreement: parties partner on a commercial initiative without forming a separate entity.

family_fields.description: Field or initiative of the alliance
family_fields.name: alliance_scope

family_fields.description: How revenue or profit is divided
family_fields.name: revenue_split

cuad_families.label: Strategic Alliance Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Supply agreement: a supplier sells goods or materials to a buyer on stated quantities and prices.
cuad_families.label: Supply Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Transportation agreement: carriage, logistics or freight services.
cuad_families.label: Transportation Agreement

cuad_families.definition: Commercial contract that fits none of the 25 listed families; extract every present category from the text and never invent a family from the filename.
cuad_families.label: Other / unlisted
